hook: An imposing nobleman steps through the smoke of a shattered cathedral doorway, instantly commanding attention as he faces a terrified crowd.
cliffhanger: Rupert screams in desperate denial that Alexander is dead, leaving the confrontation hanging in balance.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp a dramatic confrontation where a presumed dead man returns to shock his enemies, though the backstory of the usurper is missing.
narrative_context: Alexander confronts Rupert and wins over the royal guards inside the cathedral.
promotional_strength: High-stakes confrontation with strong visual imagery of an explosive return and immediate betrayal by the guards.

evidence.observation: Alexander strides through the pulverized cathedral doorway in ducal regalia.
The royal guard refuses Rupert's order to arrest Alexander.
The guard states they know who Alexander is.

logline: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot through drifting smoke and rubble across the stone floor, tilting up as polished boots step over splintered wood, revealing an imposing nobleman in a gold-embroidered navy coat.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander strides deliberately through the pulverized cathedral doorway. Dressed in the regal ducal coat with gold braided cuffs and a lion crest, his scarred face is set with cold, unyielding authority.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shocked, Trembling)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Who are you?

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Resonant)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: You already know.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, her manacled hands clutching at her smock as tears well in her eyes.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Tearful Whisper)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Alexander...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, his gaze softening momentarily toward her.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Furious, Hysterical)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Guards! Arrest this imposter!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.

source_segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Stoic, Defiant)
source_segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
source_segments.text: We will not.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: I said arrest him!

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Why?!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.

source_segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent)
source_segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
source_segments.text: Because we know who he is.

hook: Alexander advances down the aisle as his mother rushes to embrace him in front of stunned onlookers.
cliffhanger: Alexander vows to settle what Rupert stole, leaving viewers anticipating the final retaliation.
standalone_clarity: A mother identifying her long-lost son as the rightful ruler is universally understandable, even if the specifics of the usurpation require context.
narrative_context: Alexander reunites with his mother, who proclaims him the rightful Duke before he threatens Rupert.
promotional_strength: Combines emotional payoff with a powerful climax and declaration of vengeance.

evidence.observation: Alexander's mother proclaims him as Alexander Ashburn, the rightful Duke of Ashburn.
Alexander confronts Rupert and vows to settle what was stolen.

logline: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
source_segments.text: Alexander...

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Soft, Reverent)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Mother.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Overcome, Loving)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
source_segments.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Proud)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
source_segments.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Tender, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: I have come home, Mother.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Ringing, Authoritative)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
source_segments.text: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grim, Vengeful)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.
